text:
Alex: Quick sync 1) planning a KMS keystore rotation on Thu 2026-10-12 in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. 2) We need clear owners for auditlog replay and ingest backfill. Can the stage reads tolerate a short pause (~5-12m)?

Maya: I can take the ingest backfill and trigger the replay. Do we want separate canaries for Dedicated vs Hosted traffic?

Jamal: HSM team just called out a transitive dependency bump (libcrypto v2.4) that may force a keystore restart. That could blow the window if we don't run the staging bump first. @Maya can you run the bump in staging today? :eyes:

Maya: Yep, will run the staging bump after lunch and create a canary job that targets 1% traffic then 10%.

Sylvia: SRE note 1) telemetry must not drop tokens on rotation, I'll add a 10m read-cache fallback to the keystore client; 2) please ensure the read-cache toggle is behind a feature flag for fast rollback.

ops-bot: Maintenance event created: KMS keystore rotation scheduled for 2026-10-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Incident channel: #eng-oncall.

Alex: Two action items: a) who merges the read-cache/fallback PR, b) who owns the auditlog replay job and validation sampling?

Maya: I'll merge the fallback PR once canary tests pass. PR: https://github.com/redwood/keystore/pull/512  small toggle + tests. Tagging @Jamal for HSM sig checks.

Jamal: I will validate HSM signing post-bump. If I see any signature mismatches I will call a hold immediately. Also need to upload HSM attest after rotation.

Sylvia: For audit replay ownership I propose: Maya kicks the replay, Alex does validation sampling. Maya  please run the replay with a small overlap window to catch any in-flight events. Example command you can use:
```
./scripts/audit-replay --start 2026-10-12T02:00:00Z --end 2026-10-12T04:10:00Z --target staging --concurrency 3
```

Maya: Sounds good. I'll also keep concurrency low to avoid hitting production quotas. Will post the job id here once started.

Alex: Please also add a one-page rollback checklist to the rotation runbook for oncall (one-liner steps).

Sylvia: Adding rollback checklist now in the runbook:
- flip `keystore.read_cache=false` feature flag
- rollback keystore deployment to last-stable tag (`keystore@v1.24.1`)
- restore cached keys from fallback store (`/var/cache/keystore/`)
- run `make smoke` and `curl -f` probes
- if HSM sigs fail, run `scripts/hsm-verify --last-10m` and escalate to HSM oncall

Jamal: After rotation we need HSM attest JSON uploaded to the audit bucket. Maya  please ensure `hsm-attest.json` goes to `s3://redwood-audit/kms/2026-10-12/` and post the object path here. I'll verify checksum.

Maya: Will do. Flow for today: 1) staging bump + canary, 2) merge fallback toggle if canary OK, 3) rotation Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC, 4) audit replay ends + validation sampling, 5) upload attest and closure note.

Alex: TL;DR timeline and owners: staging bump (Maya), canary run (Maya), merge fallback PR (Maya), HSM sig verification (Jamal), rotation window tolerates ~5-12m ingress pause, audit replay initiated by Maya (`--end` +10m overlap), validation sampling by Alex, rollback checklist in runbook (Sylvia). Thanks all. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-10-11 09:00 UTC: KMS rotation prep checklist (canary results, PR merged, runbook updated).
